Requirements register

The complete requirement set for this project, each entry traced to the artefact that satisfies it and to an official source.

How this register is maintained

Every requirement is traced to evidence. The evidence column names the artefact that satisfies the requirement and the source column links to the official document that anchors it. A requirement is only marked Delivered when a reviewer can open the link and confirm it.
